say:1:1630524001:0.text: Singing practice! Ever since I turned into a ghost, nobody complained about my singing anymore. It's amazing!
say:1:1630524001:0.source_cn: 我在练习唱歌！自从我拥有了现在的状态，再也没有人投诉我...
say:1:1630524001:0.male: Singing practice! Ever since I turned into a ghost, nobody complained about my singing anymore. It's amazing!
say:1:1630524001:0.female: Singing practice! Ever since I turned into a ghost, nobody complained about my singing anymore. It's amazing!

say:2:1630524002:0.text: You're just in time! My ghost band needs a drummer!
say:2:1630524002:0.source_cn: 你来得正好，我的乐队正缺少一个鼓手！
say:2:1630524002:0.male: You're just in time! My ghost band needs a drummer!
say:2:1630524002:0.female: You're just in time! My ghost band needs a drummer!

say:3:1630524003:0.text: My friend! Do you crave fame? Glory? Thunderous applause?
say:3:1630524003:0.source_cn: 我的朋友，你想成为知名乐队的一员吗？你想一战成名吗？
say:3:1630524003:0.male: My friend! Do you crave fame? Glory? Thunderous applause?
say:3:1630524003:0.female: My friend! Do you crave fame? Glory? Thunderous applause?

say:4:1630524004:0.text: Then come, join me on stage! Tonight, we perform at the grand ball!
say:4:1630524004:0.source_cn: 跟我一起登上舞台吧！我们一起为舞会表演！
say:4:1630524004:0.male: Then come, join me on stage! Tonight, we perform at the grand ball!
say:4:1630524004:0.female: Then come, join me on stage! Tonight, we perform at the grand ball!

say:5:1630524005:0.text: Although... uh... you don't seem to have hands. That might be a problem.
say:5:1630524005:0.source_cn: 不过你看起来并没有手可以拿鼓槌……
say:5:1630524005:0.male: Although... uh... you don't seem to have hands. That might be a problem.
say:5:1630524005:0.female: Although... uh... you don't seem to have hands. That might be a problem.
